name: Alert
summary: +5 initiative; you cannot be surprised while conscious; hidden attackers do not gain advantage just for being unseen.

name: Athlete
summary: Improve physical mobility: standing from prone is cheaper, climbing is easier, and running jumps need less run-up.

name: Actor
summary: Excel at impersonation and performance; gain advantage when pretending to be someone else and mimic voices or sounds you have studied.

name: Charger
summary: After using Dash, use a bonus action to make a melee attack or shove, with an extra benefit after a straight-line charge.

name: Crossbow Expert
summary: Ignore crossbow loading, make ranged attacks normally in melee, and gain a hand-crossbow bonus-action attack after attacking one-handed.

name: Defensive Duelist
summary: When wielding a finesse weapon, use your reaction to add proficiency bonus to AC against one melee attack that hits you.

name: Dual Wielder
summary: Better two-weapon fighting: +1 AC while dual-wielding, use non-light one-handed weapons, and draw or stow two weapons together.

name: Dungeon Delver
summary: Better at finding and surviving traps and secret doors; resist trap damage and search while travelling at normal pace.

name: Durable
summary: Become tougher and get a better minimum result when spending Hit Dice to regain hit points.

name: Elemental Adept
summary: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Your spells ignore resistance to that type and treat damage-die rolls of 1 as 2.

name: Grappler
summary: Gain advantage on attacks against creatures you grapple and gain an option to restrain both yourself and the grappled creature.

name: Great Weapon Master
summary: Heavy-weapon specialist: gain a bonus attack after a critical hit or dropping a creature, and trade accuracy for major damage.

name: Healer
summary: Use a healer's kit much more effectively, including restoring hit points instead of merely stabilising a dying creature.

name: Heavily Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with heavy armour.

name: Heavy Armor Master
summary: While wearing heavy armour, reduce incoming nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

name: Inspiring Leader
summary: Spend 10 minutes inspiring up to six allies so they gain temporary hit points based on your level and Charisma modifier.

name: Keen Mind
summary: Perfectly track direction and time, and accurately recall what you have seen or heard during the past month.

name: Lightly Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with light armour.

name: Linguist
summary: Learn three languages and become skilled at creating written ciphers that others struggle to decipher.

name: Lucky
summary: Gain three luck points per long rest to influence your own attacks, checks, saves, or attacks made against you.

name: Mage Slayer
summary: Fight spellcasters at close range: punish nearby casting, disrupt concentration more effectively, and resist nearby spells better.

name: Magic Initiate
summary: Learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell from another spellcasting class; cast the 1st-level spell once per long rest.

name: Martial Adept
summary: Learn two Battle Master manoeuvres and gain one superiority die to fuel them, refreshed on a short or long rest.

name: Medium Armor Master
summary: Use medium armour more efficiently: remove its Stealth penalty and allow up to +3 Dexterity to AC.

name: Mobile
summary: Increase speed, Dash through difficult terrain more easily, and avoid opportunity attacks from creatures you attack in melee.

name: Moderately Armored
summary: Gain proficiency with medium armour and shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
summary: Become more dangerous and protective while mounted, including advantage against smaller unmounted foes and ways to protect your mount.

name: Observant
summary: Read lips when you can see a speaker and gain +5 to passive Perception and passive Investigation.

name: Polearm Master
summary: Gain a bonus-action butt-end attack with certain polearms and trigger opportunity attacks when enemies enter your reach.

name: Resilient
summary: Increase one ability score by 1 and gain proficiency in saving throws using that ability.

name: Ritual Caster
summary: Gain a ritual book with two 1st-level ritual spells from a chosen class and copy more qualifying rituals into it later.

name: Savage Attacker
summary: Once per turn when rolling melee-weapon damage, reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either result.

name: Sentinel
summary: Lock enemies down with opportunity attacks and punish foes who attack nearby allies instead of you.

name: Sharpshooter
summary: Ignore long-range disadvantage and most cover with ranged weapons, and trade accuracy for a large damage bonus.

name: Shield Master
summary: Turn a shield into an active combat tool: shove after attacking, improve some Dexterity saves, and potentially negate certain area damage.

name: Skilled
summary: Gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools.

name: Skulker
summary: Hide more effectively in dim conditions, missing with a ranged attack does not automatically reveal you, and dim light does not hinder Perception as much.

name: Spell Sniper
summary: Double the range of attack-roll spells, ignore half and three-quarters cover with them, and learn one attack cantrip from a spellcasting class.

name: Tavern Brawler
summary: Become proficient with improvised weapons, improve unarmed damage, and grapple as a bonus action after hitting with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon.

name: Tough
summary: Your hit-point maximum increases by 2 per character level, including retroactively for levels you already have.

name: War Caster
summary: Gain advantage on Constitution saves to maintain concentration, cast with occupied hands, and use certain spells for opportunity attacks.

name: Weapon Master
summary: Gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice.
